title: Gift Cards & Store Credit Cash-Out and Consolidation Eligibility Matrix
content:
Only paid-for Gift Cards & Store Credit types can be cashed out where a holder's billing-state law requires it, and only the same three types can have their balances combined. Every type requires the holder personally to confirm a cash-out.

## Cash-out

| Instrument type | Eligible for cash-out where billing-state law requires it | How a cash-out is paid | Business days to issue the payment after confirmation | Holder must personally confirm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | No | Not applicable | 0 (not eligible) | Yes |
| Bonus Gift Card | No | Not applicable | 0 (not eligible) | Yes |
| Goodwill Credit | No | Not applicable | 0 (not eligible) | Yes |
| Return Store Credit | Yes | Mailed check | 10 | Yes |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | Mailed check | 10 | Yes |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Yes | Mailed check | 10 | Yes |

## Consolidation

| Instrument type | Balances of several instruments of the type can be combined | Fewest instruments in one consolidation | Type that receives the combined balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | No | 0 (not allowed) | Not applicable |
| Bonus Gift Card | No | 0 (not allowed) | Not applicable |
| Goodwill Credit | No | 0 (not allowed) | Not applicable |
| Return Store Credit | Yes | 2 | Return Store Credit |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | 2 | Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Yes | 2 | Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card |

## Reading the matrix

- A plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card consolidates into a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card, never into another plastic card; Return Store Credit consolidates into Return Store Credit.
- A single instrument on its own never makes a consolidation: the fewest instruments in one consolidation is two for each type that allows it.
- The three promotional types (Marlowe Rewards Note, Bonus Gift Card, Goodwill Credit) are neither cashed out nor consolidated.
- A cash-out check is issued within 10 business days after the holder's confirmation.
